This '''Rebel outpost''' was located on a seldom-traveled [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet of [[Cataalda]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] it was discovered by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol, which resulted in a hasty evacuation of all [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] personnel.
